line.s_ask.text: Fox, will you make me a round window for my birdhouse?

line.s_here.text: Done! Here you are, your window.

line.s_not_round.text: But this window is not round at all! It has corners and straight sides.

line.s_same.text: A window is a window. Does it matter?

line.s_differ.text: No! Every shape is different. I wanted a window round like the moon, and this one has corners and straight sides.

line.s_how.text: Then how do I tell which shape is which?

line.s_corners.text: By the corners and the sides! I will show you, it is fun.

line.s_circle.text: This is a circle. It is round like a ball and has no corners at all.

line.s_triangle.text: This is a triangle. Count its corners. Point to each corner in turn.

line.s_three_corners.text: A triangle has three corners and three sides.

line.s_square.text: This is a square. Now you count the corners.

line.s_four_corners.text: Four corners! A square has four equal sides.

line.s_rectangle.text: This is a rectangle. It has four corners too, but two sides are longer and two are shorter.

line.s_point_circle.text: Owl wanted a round window. Point to the circle.

line.wrong_shape.text: That is another shape. Look at the corners.

line.wrong_shape.lisek.text: That is another shape. Look at the corners.

line.s_solved.text: Now I know! A round window is a circle. I will make one.

line.s_to_playground.text: Let's go to the playground. There are shapes there too.

line.b_blocks.text: Someone left blocks of two shapes here. Let's tidy up.

line.b_sort.text: Circles into the basket, triangles into the box. Look at the corners, not the colours!

line.b_mixed.text: Something got mixed up. A circle has no corners and a triangle has three.

line.b_done.text: Well done! All the circles together, all the triangles together.

line.b_turned.text: Careful, I turned one shape. But it still has four equal sides. Point to the square.

line.b_still_square.text: A turned square is still a square!

line.b_to_orchard.text: And now to the orchard. We will build a birdhouse in the tree.

line.c_build.text: Let's build Owl a birdhouse. The walls are ready, that is a square.

line.c_roof.text: Now the roof. Drag the triangle onto the square.

line.c_roof_wrong.text: The roof goes on top, on the square.

line.c_window.text: And now the round window. Drag the circle into the middle of the square.

line.c_window_wrong.text: The window goes in the middle of the wall.

line.c_solved.text: My birdhouse! A triangle roof and a round window. Thank you!

line.p_intro.text: Let's play finding shapes! The colours can be different.

line.a_game.text: Let's play finding shapes at home.

line.a_ok.text: All right! I show a thing and you find its shape.

line.a_talerz.text: What shape is a plate? Point to the shape.

line.a_klocek.text: What shape is the side of a block? Point to the shape.

line.a_ask_parents.text: Ask your parents to look for circles, squares and triangles at home with you.

line.wrong_sides.text: Look at the sides. A square has all sides equal, and a rectangle has two longer ones.

line.wrong_sides.lisek.text: Look at the sides. A square has all sides equal, and a rectangle has two longer ones.

line.a_ciastko.text: What shape is a cookie? Point to the shape.

line.a_three_corners.text: Which shape has three corners? Point to it.

line.a_four_corners.text: Which shape has four corners? Point to it.

line.a_no_corners.text: And which one has no corners at all?
